model: Samba Active Directory domain controller (samba-tool provisioned, realm LAB.OPENMAP.TEST, DC01), Debian 12 packages samba/samba-ad-dc 2:4.17.12+dfsg-0+deb12u4

capture.command: privileged debian:12 container (hostname dc01, 10.250.70.10 on fxlab-e): apt-get install samba samba-ad-dc samba-ad-provision winbind krb5-user ldb-tools; samba-tool domain provision --realm=LAB.OPENMAP.TEST --domain=LAB --server-role=dc --dns-backend=SAMBA_INTERNAL --use-rfc2307; smb.conf `ldap server require strong auth = no`; samba -i; samba-tool ou create (Service Accounts, Servers), user create aisha.rahman / omar.haddad (then user disable omar.haddad) / svc-sql (spn add MSSQLSvc/db01.lab.openmap.test:1433) / svc-backup (setexpiry --noexpiry), group add NetOps / DBA with addmembers (aisha.rahman also in Domain Admins), computer create APP01 (OU=Servers) / WKS042; port 389 published on 127.0.0.1:13891; the collector's own directory.Search(..., "Administrator@lab.openmap.test", <random lab password>, baseDN="" (root DSE defaultNamingContext), includeComputers=true) ran through a byte-recording TCP proxy.
